integrity: Mathematical proof and finite exact checks provided; finite checks do not establish universal statements; independent review pending.
scientific_limitations: Complex smooth fibers only; exact periods three through five, not other orders. The irreducible fifth-order locus is not a universal modular classification; potential prior equivalent specialization of classical QRT torsion criteria remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact order-three, order-four and order-five loci for a symmetric QRT elliptic family
